Control Objective: Ensure new user access is authorized and appropriate
Test Procedure: Select 10 new user accounts and verify approved access requests manager authorization and role assignments
Evidence Required: Access request tickets manager approvals account creation records and role assignments
Expected Result: All sampled users have documented approval and appropriate access
Risk if Control Fails: Unauthorized or excessive access may be granted

Control Objective: Ensure terminated user access is removed promptly
Test Procedure: Select 10 terminated users and compare termination time to account disablement and access removal records
Evidence Required: HR termination records disablement logs and access removal tickets
Expected Result: All terminated users have access removed within the required timeframe
Risk if Control Fails: Former employees may retain access to systems and data

Control Objective: Ensure privileged access is justified approved and periodically reviewed
Test Procedure: Select 8 privileged accounts and verify business justification owner approval current role and latest access review
Evidence Required: Privileged account inventory business justification review approvals and role assignments
Expected Result: All privileged accounts are justified approved and appropriate
Risk if Control Fails: Excessive privileged access may enable unauthorized changes or data exposure

Control Objective: Ensure applicable privileged and remote accounts are protected by MFA
Test Procedure: Compare privileged and remote user inventories to MFA enrollment data and inspect approved exceptions
Evidence Required: MFA enrollment report authentication policy and exception approvals
Expected Result: All applicable accounts are enrolled in MFA or have valid approved exceptions
Risk if Control Fails: Compromised credentials may result in unauthorized access

Control Objective: Ensure user access is reviewed periodically and unnecessary access is removed
Test Procedure: Review quarterly access certification evidence and select 10 sampled users to verify reviewer decision and remediation of identified access issues
Evidence Required: Access review reports manager certifications and access removal records
Expected Result: Reviews are completed on schedule and identified unnecessary access is removed
Risk if Control Fails: Excessive or outdated access may persist

Control Objective: Ensure production changes are authorized tested documented and approved
Test Procedure: Select 10 production changes and inspect request approval testing implementation and closure evidence
Evidence Required: Change tickets testing records approvals and implementation logs
Expected Result: All sampled changes follow the approved change process
Risk if Control Fails: Unauthorized or untested changes may cause outages security issues or compliance failures

Control Objective: Ensure security-relevant events are logged reviewed and investigated
Test Procedure: Inspect SIEM log source inventory and review recurring log review records and associated investigation tickets
Evidence Required: SIEM reports log source inventory review records and incident tickets
Expected Result: Required systems generate logs and reviews are documented with investigation evidence
Risk if Control Fails: Security incidents may go undetected or lack investigation evidence

Control Objective: Ensure high-risk vulnerabilities are identified prioritized and remediated
Test Procedure: Select 10 High or Critical vulnerabilities and compare detection dates severity remediation actions closure dates and exceptions
Evidence Required: Vulnerability reports remediation tickets aging reports patch evidence and risk acceptance records
Expected Result: High-risk findings meet defined remediation timelines or have approved exceptions

Control Objective: Ensure security incidents are documented escalated contained and reviewed
Test Procedure: Select 5 security incidents and inspect classification timeline investigation escalation containment and closure records
Evidence Required: Incident tickets investigation notes escalation records and incident reports
Expected Result: All sampled incidents follow documented response procedures
Risk if Control Fails: Incidents may be mishandled delayed or inadequately documented

Control Objective: Ensure incident response procedures are periodically tested
Test Procedure: Inspect the latest tabletop exercise for scenario participants decisions lessons learned and corrective actions
Evidence Required: Tabletop exercise report participant list lessons learned and action tracker
Expected Result: A recent exercise demonstrates testing and documented follow-up
Risk if Control Fails: Response procedures may fail during a real incident

Control Objective: Ensure backups are completed and recoverability is validated
Test Procedure: Review backup success reports and inspect 4 restoration tests for successful recovery and documented corrective actions
Evidence Required: Backup reports restoration test records recovery logs and issue tickets
Expected Result: All tested backups restore successfully or failed tests have documented remediation
Risk if Control Fails: Data or systems may not be recoverable after disruption

Control Objective: Ensure high-risk vendors receive due diligence and recurring reassessment
Test Procedure: Select 5 high-risk vendors and verify initial assessment current reassessment evidence risk rating contracts and open remediation items
Evidence Required: Vendor questionnaires risk assessments contracts compliance reports and remediation tracker
Expected Result: All high-risk vendors have current risk assessments and tracked findings
Risk if Control Fails: Third-party weaknesses may introduce unmanaged security or compliance risk

Control Objective: Ensure key security policies are current approved and periodically reviewed
Test Procedure: Inspect selected policies for ownership approval version date review cycle and current requirements
Evidence Required: Current policy documents approval records and revision history
Expected Result: All sampled policies are current approved and within the required review cycle
Risk if Control Fails: Outdated policies may fail to reflect current risk and control expectations

Control Objective: Ensure cybersecurity risks have owners ratings treatment decisions and management oversight
Test Procedure: Select 10 open risks and verify risk rating owner treatment action status and approval
Evidence Required: Risk register management approvals treatment plans and status records
Expected Result: All sampled risks have complete ownership rating treatment and approval information
Risk if Control Fails: Material risks may remain unmanaged or lack accountability

Control Objective: Ensure audit findings are tracked and validated before closure
Test Procedure: Select 10 prior findings and inspect owner due date corrective action validation evidence and closure approval
Evidence Required: Finding tracker remediation evidence validation records and closure approvals
Expected Result: Closed findings have sufficient evidence and open items are actively tracked
Risk if Control Fails: Issues may be closed prematurely or remain unresolved
